questions.questionText: Which stream has the shortest stacked bar (lowest total student enrolment)?
questions.explanation: Totals: Arts 600, Science 970, Commerce 760, Engineering 700, Law 810, Management 850. Lowest: Arts.

questions.questionText: What is the difference between the total student enrolment of Engineering and Management?
questions.explanation: Totals: Engineering = 700, Management = 850; difference = 150. Read the needed values straight from the graph data and apply the operation asked.

questions.questionText: The total bar of Management is what percentage more than the total bar of Arts (correct to one decimal place)?
questions.explanation: (850 - 600)/600 × 100 = 41.67 ≈ 41.7%. Read the needed values straight from the graph data and apply the operation asked.
questions.shortcut: Base is the smaller total.

questions.questionText: In Engineering, what is the ratio of the Boys segment to the Girls segment?
questions.explanation: 230 : 470 reduced by their HCF gives 23 : 47. Read the needed values straight from the graph data and apply the operation asked.

questions.questionText: Over all 6 streams together, what percentage of the overall total student enrolment is contributed by Girls (correct to one decimal place)?
questions.explanation: Girls total = 2260; grand total = 4690; ratio = 48.19 ≈ 48.2%. Read the needed values straight from the graph data and apply the operation asked.
questions.shortcut: Use sums, not an average of per-bar percentages.
